Title: General availability: Announcing lower pricing for provisioned throughput on Azure Ultra Disks

Body.Content:
As part of our commitment to delivering the best possible value for Azure customers, we are announcing a price reduction on provisioned throughput for Azure Ultra Disks by 65%. The new pricing is effective May 1st, 2021, and applies to all the regions where Ultra Disks are available. Azure Ultra Disks offer high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low latency disk storage for Azure Virtual Machines (VMs).

See Azure Ultra Disks pricing.

Learn more about Azure Ultra Disks.
